heading: Playing the Same Numbers for Decades Yields Irish Lotto Jackpot
description: A Galway woman has won a €7 million Lotto Jackpot after 25 years of playing the same set of birthday numbers.
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
Galway Woman Wins €7 Million

A woman from Galway is celebrating a life-changing €7,028,440 Irish Lotto Jackpot win from the draw on November 19th. Her winning ticket, purchased at Eurospar in Carraroe, carried a set of special numbers she’s been loyal to for 25 years—each tied to a family birthday. She claimed her big prize this week in Dublin.

In the National Lottery Winners Room, the elated winner, who has chosen to remain anonymous, shared the unforgettable moment she discovered her good fortune. “I scanned my ticket on the app, and it said, ‘You’ve won big.’ I had no clue how big until I called the Prize Claims Team,” she said.

The Moment Everything Changed

Her first contact was with Martin Monaghan from the National Lottery, who made sure to prepare her for the news. “Martin asked if I was sitting down. When he told me I’d won €7 million, I was completely speechless. It’s a moment that will stay with me forever,” she revealed.

This isn’t her first brush with luck, either. Over two decades ago, she matched four numbers on the Lotto and won €27. “I never thought those same numbers would one day bring me something so extraordinary,” she added.

Now adjusting to her newfound fortune, she’s already making plans to share her success. “I’m excited to help my family and friends,” she said. “It’s such a joy to be able to give back.”

The Irish Lotto Shines

Stories like these highlight the impact of Irish Lotto players, as nearly 30 cents of every euro spent on tickets goes to Good Causes. Since its establishment 37 years ago, the Irish National Lottery has raised over €6.5 billion for projects in areas like youth, health, education, sports, arts, and heritage. In 2023 alone, €227.9 million was distributed to local communities across Ireland.

The Irish Lotto has long been a popular choice amongst international enthusiasts.
